key_insight: Metadata-Driven AI keeps raw data away from the LLM and turns each generated analysis into a reusable program, reducing repeated inference.
engineering_relevance: For photovoltaic site prospection, this architecture supports analysis over live geospatial APIs while executing generated programs next to the data.
method: Send only metadata—not actual data—across a one-way inference boundary to the LLM.
Execute the generated analysis program next to the data.
Retain and reuse the program without new inference for each run.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a cost model, metadata-transfer measurements on public datasets, a small locally hosted model benchmark, and three application demonstrations, including photovoltaic prospection.
watch_item: Generated programs still require validation, and changes to data schemas or APIs may require regeneration.
paper_title: Metadata-Driven AI: An Architectural Pattern for Sustainable Data Analysis with LLMs
